app.name: Tadhkirah
app.tagline: Remember, reflect, return, and improve — one day at a time.

landing.heroTitle: Gently hold yourself to account, and return to Allah every day
landing.heroBody: Tadhkirah is a calm, private space to review your day, keep your prayers and Quran portion, and remember authentic Sunnahs at the right moments — without points, comparisons or blame.
landing.heroNote: No password · No ads · Your data is yours alone
landing.featuresTitle: Everything you need for a day closer to Allah
landing.feature1Body: Daily questions you choose yourself, with room for gratitude, repentance and tomorrow's intention.
landing.feature2Body: Follow your prayers, adhkar and voluntary worship, with a clear line between obligatory and voluntary.
landing.feature3Body: Record your recitation, memorization and revision by surah and ayah.
landing.feature4Body: Reminders of Sunnahs and times of supplication, each with its source and grading, after scholarly review.
landing.dayBody: Tadhkirah calculates prayer times for your city on your device, and your day starts at Fajr — so Isha and Witr count for their day, even after midnight.
landing.principle1Body: Your reflections are yours alone. We never show them to anyone, sell them, or train any AI on them.
landing.principle2Body: No weak or fabricated hadith. Nothing is published without documented human review.
landing.principle3Body: No points, rankings or blame. We help you keep going and return — not compete.
landing.ctaBody: Two minutes to set up, then one day at a time, in shā' Allāh.
landing.footer: Made with care to help you do good.
landing.mockReflect: A moment to look back on your day
landing.skyHint: Tap a time to see its sky
landing.t1Body: Begin with the intention you wrote last night.
landing.t2Body: Log each prayer at its time with a single tap — no fuss.
landing.t3Body: A gentle nudge for evening adhkar and your Quran portion.
landing.t4Body: Authentic Sunnahs, with their sources, at the right moment.
landing.t5Body: Look back on your day, give thanks, and set tomorrow's intention.

admin.title: Review desk
admin.policyBanner: Nothing is published until a reviewer other than its author has verified it and a publisher has approved it. Da'if and mawdu' narrations are never published.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: Tadhkirah is a personal companion for self-accountability, and what you write in it is a trust. This page explains plainly what we collect, why, how we protect it, and how you control it.
privacy.s1_body:
• Your email address, to sign you in (no password). If you choose to sign in with Google or Apple, we receive from them only your email address and an account identifier: never your name, contacts or password.
• Your settings: your name if you add one, language, time zone and digit style.
• An approximate location to calculate prayer times: we store coordinates rounded to about one kilometre, and we never track your location.
• What you record: prayers and worship, Quran progress, daily reflections, weekly reviews and goals.
• Reminder settings, and your notification subscription if you turn notifications on.
• Signed-in devices: browser and operating system name, and last activity. We do not store IP addresses with your account.
privacy.s2_body:
Your private text (reflections, weekly reviews, goals, and your own questions and reminder titles) is encrypted with a key that is yours alone before it is stored. This protects it if the database ever leaks.

To be honest about it: this is server-side encryption, not end-to-end encryption; the service decrypts your text to show it to you. No one on the team reads it, and it never appears in logs or analytics.
privacy.s3_body:
• We don't sell your data or share it for advertising.
• No ads, and no cross-site tracking.
• No faith scores, and no comparing you with others.
privacy.s4_body: We use one essential cookie to keep you signed in. On public pages only (the home and sign-in pages) we count visits with Vercel Web Analytics, which uses no cookies and records only the page path. There are no analytics inside the app once you are signed in.
privacy.s5_title: Who processes data on our behalf
privacy.s5_body:
• Vercel: hosts the app (Frankfurt, Germany).
• Neon: the database (Frankfurt, Germany).
• Google (Gmail): sends your sign-in code emails.
• Google and Apple: confirm who you are, only if you choose to sign in with them.
• Your browser's push service (Google, Apple or Mozilla): delivers reminders, encrypted, to your device if you turn them on.
• Cloudflare: triggers the reminder schedule; none of your data passes through it.

These providers handle technical data such as IP addresses to deliver the service and keep it only briefly. Our abuse protection keeps an IP address for no more than one day.
privacy.s6_body:
• Your data: until you delete it or your account.
• Notification history: 90 days; reminders already sent: 30 days.
• Device records: 90 days after they expire.
• The database provider's backups: expire within 35 days at most.
privacy.s7_body:
From Settings, at any time, you can:
• Export all your data (readable text or JSON).
• Change your settings and turn off any reminder.
• Delete your account: your reflections' encryption key is destroyed at once, so they can never be read again, and then all your data is deleted.

For any question or request about your data, write to the address below.
privacy.s8_body: If we change anything material in this policy, we'll tell you inside the app before it takes effect and update the date on this page.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: By using Tadhkirah you agree to these terms. We've written them simply, so you know what you can expect and what we ask of you.
terms.s1_body: A free personal tool that helps you keep your worship consistent and hold yourself to account gently. It isn't a social network, and it judges no one's faith.
terms.s2_body: We publish a hadith or Sunnah only after reviewers have checked it, with its source, grading and who graded it, and any scholarly difference noted. Even so, Tadhkirah is not a source of fatwa: ask qualified scholars about your questions. If you see a mistake, tell us with the “Report a problem with this source” button.
terms.s3_body: Prayer times are calculated astronomically using the method you choose, and can differ by a few minutes from your mosque's timetable. Follow your mosque's adhan when they differ; you can adjust the minutes in Settings.
terms.s4_title: Your account and what you write
terms.s4_body: Keep your email secure: anyone who can read it can sign in to your account. What you write belongs to you. We use it only to provide the service to you, and you can export or delete it whenever you like.
terms.s5_body: Don't try to access other people's data, disrupt the service or overload it with automated requests, or misuse the report button. We may suspend an account that does.
terms.s6_body: We do our best to keep Tadhkirah running, but we provide it as it is, without a guarantee that it will never be interrupted or that a reminder will never be late. We may improve or change its features, and if we ever shut it down we'll tell you in advance so you can export your data.
terms.s7_body: To the extent the law allows, we aren't liable for any indirect harm resulting from using the service or being unable to use it.
terms.s8_body: If we change these terms materially, we'll tell you in the app before the change takes effect. Continuing to use the app afterwards means you accept them, and you can delete your account if you don't.
